profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full Stack Engineer | React | TypeScript | Node.js | Microservices | Cloud Native | AWS | Azure | GCP | AI-Assisted Development
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer and Full Stack Engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable, cloud-native applications across healthcare, fintech, public sector, defense, and startup environments. My expertise spans React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Ruby on Rails, Scala, REST APIs, microservices, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, with a strong focus on building reliable and maintainable software.

I specialize in full-stack development, system architecture, application modernization, cloud-native engineering, and technical leadership. I have experience decomposing monolithic applications, developing microservices and APIs, building reusable React component libraries and design systems, implementing CI/CD pipelines, improving application performance and security, and leading technical discovery and delivery. I also leverage AI-assisted development with Claude Code to accelerate development, refactoring, documentation, component delivery, and engineering workflows while maintaining strong engineering standards.

I enjoy solving complex technical challenges and collaborating with engineering, product, UX, and client stakeholders to turn requirements into production-ready solutions. I bring a practical approach to balancing scalability, performance, security, accessibility, maintainability, and delivery, while taking ownership from technical discovery through implementation and deployment. I’m always interested in building impactful products, improving engineering practices, and contributing to teams that value innovation, collaboration, and high-quality software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led monolithic decomposition by extracting the frontend web application into a standalone repository, improving build isolation, deployment independence, and team ownership across active sprint work.
• Served as technical lead across project tooling, UX direction, and sprint planning, helping reduce delivery ambiguity and keep engineering execution aligned with product priorities.
• Partnered with UX to define core designs for the component library and audited reusable UI gaps, creating a scalable roadmap for consistent frontend delivery.
• Built and configured CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI, Terraform, and Docker, improving release repeatability and reducing manual deployment steps across development environments.
• Developed reusable React and TypeScript web components aligned with design-system patterns, improving UI consistency and reducing duplicated frontend code.
• Implemented MQTT-based messaging for IoT device communication, enabling reliable low-latency telemetry across connected hardware workflows.
• Completed architecture research and discovery tickets for backend platform decisions, reducing technical risk before implementation and improving estimation accuracy.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Serve as technical lead and solution architect for a security workforce management platform, owning architecture across React frontend, Node.js APIs, and third-party integrations.
• Re-architected the frontend away from Material UI into a custom React component library and design system, improving accessibility, UI consistency, and long-term maintainability.
• Designed scalable Node.js REST APIs supporting user workflows, leadership dashboards, and administrative portals while enforcing validation, authentication, and authorization controls.
• Built proof-of-concept solutions and stakeholder demos to validate feasibility early, reducing downstream rework and improving delivery confidence across sprint cycles.
• Scoped engineering work, estimated effort, and defined milestones for Agile delivery, supporting predictable execution across multi-workstream development.
• Partnered with client stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage scope changes, and ensure solutions met functional, security, and performance expectations.
• Implemented Swagger and Postman documentation workflows, improving developer onboarding and API integration reliability for internal and client teams.
• Enforced code review, performance tuning, and maintainable architecture practices, reducing production defects and improving release quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Delivered scalable product features within a hybrid architecture using Ruby on Rails, NestJS, TypeScript, and service-oriented backend components.
• Integrated Docker and Kubernetes into deployment workflows, improving environment consistency and contributing to an estimated 10% reduction in infrastructure costs.
• Implemented OAuth 2.0 and JWT authentication flows, strengthening security posture and reducing identified access-related vulnerabilities by approximately 35%.
• Contributed to monolith decomposition into a team-owned service supporting targeted intervention programs, improving modularity and deployment independence.
• Designed backend services with NestJS and TypeScript, emphasizing clean contracts, scalable patterns, and strong unit and integration test coverage.
• Built reusable React Native components, improving mobile UI consistency and reducing duplicate implementation across feature teams.
• Led development of iOS Live Activities for a connected medical device, architecting the solution from scratch to support multiple product offerings.
• Increased reliability through unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, reducing regression risk across healthcare product releases.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Owned and evolved the web bank-linking experience, contributing to a 22% increase in user engagement through workflow optimization and UX improvements.
• Designed, implemented, and A/B tested React features to improve onboarding conversion while maintaining frontend performance and accessibility standards.
• Built API integrations for bank-linking microservices through a Backend-for-Frontend layer implemented in Scala.
• Migrated legacy Ruby on Rails backend functionality into modern Scala microservices, helping the platform scale to support 2.5M+ users.
• Conducted frontend stress testing and performance optimization to resolve bottlenecks during high-traffic onboarding usage.
• Collaborated with product managers and designers to translate mockups into production-ready UI components and user flows.
• Built JavaScript-based end-to-end test coverage, stabilizing a mission-critical onboarding workflow and reducing release regressions.
• Performed code reviews and mentored peers, improving code quality and reducing long-term technical debt.

positions.title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Delivered secure, scalable features across financial services platforms supporting daily operations, customer-facing workflows, and lender integrations.
• Performed SQL performance tuning and query optimization, improving data retrieval efficiency by 25% and reducing response times on high-traffic endpoints.
• Designed REST APIs integrating third-party financial systems, ensuring reliable data exchange, validation, and consistent service contracts.
• Led modernization work by migrating legacy components toward microservices, improving modularity and deployment velocity.
• Built React and TypeScript frontend features, enhancing usability, responsiveness, and maintainability across lending workflows.
• Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, streamlining build, test, and release processes for application teams.
• Improved quality outcomes by achieving approximately 95% unit and integration test coverage using xUnit and Moq.
• Strengthened application security by implementing OAuth 2.0 and role-based access control, reducing access-related vulnerabilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Designed and developed embedded software in C and C++ for flight simulation hardware, contributing to a 15% improvement in system performance.
• Rapidly prototyped a touchscreen GUI controller using IoT-driven approaches, reducing user interaction time by 30%.
• Replaced legacy embedded hardware with Raspberry Pi-based systems and custom firmware, reducing hardware costs by 40%.
• Engineered low-latency data transmission workflows, reducing control data latency by 25% and lowering operational costs by 15%.
• Installed, configured, and validated flight simulator software across integrated hardware environments.
• Authored technical documentation supporting maintenance, onboarding, and future system enhancements.

positions.title: IT Intern / Business Analyst Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and developed internal web applications using Vue.js, HTML, and CSS, improving employee productivity and workflow efficiency.
• Built SQL-driven enforcement reports and dashboards, translating operational requirements into actionable insights.
• Created interactive map services visualizing water consumption activity for 104,000+ residents, supporting data-driven decision-making.
• Provided hands-on technical support to city employees, resolving system issues and improving service responsiveness.
• Partnered with stakeholders to gather requirements, validate outputs, and refine reporting logic.
